data.name: caption_text
data.value: Find model problems early and save your time.

data.name: about_text
data.value: Revit Linter checks projects and families, collects findings and helps you inspect or fix the affected elements.

data.name: workflow_text
data.value: Revit model → Diagnostics → Findings → Show or fix → Export report

data.name: tab_format
data.value: Revit Linter adds the "{0}" tab to the Revit ribbon at startup.

data.name: parameters_text
data.value: When a document is opened or created, the add-in adds two shared project parameters to it: Linter_Ignored and Linter_IgnoredType. They store the list of ignored findings, so the model is modified.
